description: This file implements a custom React hook 'useLogin' for handling user login process, including email authentication, multi-factor authentication, and password authentication, with state management, error handling, and integration with various services.

methods.name: validateInfo
methods.description: Validates that email and password fields are filled based on the current login step.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs the login process, handling email authentication, MFA, and password authentication, with error handling and state updates.

methods.name: finishWithError
methods.description: Handles login errors, resets login step if necessary, and shows error messages.

methods.name: finishLogin
methods.description: Completes the login process by fetching user data, updating premium status, and showing success message.
